query: How do I reset a tripped circuit breaker?
answer: First, find the tripped breaker in your panel. It's usually stuck in the middle between ON and OFF, or flipped the opposite way from the others [1][2]. Next, unplug or turn off the things on that circuit so the breaker isn't reset under load [1]. Then push the switch all the way to OFF until it clicks, and flip it back to ON. A breaker won't reset if you just push it from the middle straight to ON [1][2]. After that, plug things back in one at a time. If it trips again as you add devices, the circuit is probably overloaded and you should move something to a different circuit [2]. If it trips again right away with nothing plugged in, don't keep resetting it. That points to a fault such as a short, not an overload [3]. Call an electrician, and call right away if you smell burning or see sparks or scorch marks [2].
